marketRegime: Choppy/low-momentum crypto microstructure: most observed moves cluster in the 6-18bps range (sub-threshold for reliable follow-through), peer consensus is frequently 4/0 'all-agree' yet this consensus is NOT predictive (all-agree bucket underwater), and strong directional moves (20+bps) are rare but are the only consistently profitable regime. This looks like a mean-reverting/noisy 5-minute window environment rather than trending, which explains why momentum entries at low move magnitude or late in the window systematically lose.

Lowering to a more realistic 40 and enforcing it strictly reduces slippage risk on illiquid legs without starving the bot of its only available setups; this is a calibration fix rather than a loosening.

Observed stop-loss exits firing as low as bid=0.19-0.25 from entries around 0.55-0.60, implying large realized losses per stopped-out trade (worst trade -$15.93). Combined with stop_loss_bid, raising the stop fraction tightens the exit trigger relative to entry price, cutting tail losses like the -$15.93 worst trade and the broad left<60 bucket loss of -$19.40/13 trades (84.6% loss rate) which likely includes positions that were allowed to decay too long before stopping out.

Overall the bot is in a fragile breakeven-to-losing state that is being incrementally corrected by its own lesson/veto system, but needs several more explicit parameter tightenings to stop known-bad patterns.
